study: Joint MMLU PE-EmbPT concatenated and model-specific prompt-effect comparison

task.scope: A joint model-prompt replay. Upstream PromptEval evaluated prompts within each model.

features.source: Frozen upstream PromptEval PCA feature values retained from the first version
features.interaction_row_rule: For arm (model m, prompt p), place the unchanged 25 prompt values in model block m, put zeros in all other prompt blocks, and append the unchanged 14 model indicators.
features.interaction_sharing: All 100 prompts for the same model share that model's 25 prompt coefficients. Different model blocks can learn different prompt effects.
features.question_effects: N question identity columns shared across all 1,500 arms for a subject with N questions

fitting.response_source: Observed binary matrix entries from the current and prior phases, including previously eliminated arms
fitting.concat_logit: Shared prompt score + reference-coded model offset + shared question coefficient
fitting.interaction_logit: Model-specific prompt score + reference-coded model offset + shared question coefficient
fitting.rasch_score: Average across all N questions. Preserve observed responses and use fitted sigmoid probabilities for unseen entries.
fitting.regularization_caveat: C=100 fixes the coefficient penalty strength, while the function-space penalty depends on the design. Repeating the same 25-vector in all 15 interaction blocks incurs 15 times the concatenated prompt penalty. This compares the full fitted implementations.

allocation.arm_rule: Seeded uniform choice among least-sampled active arms
allocation.recommendation_rule: NumPy argmax on the active-arm score order at each phase
allocation.elimination_rule: Remove ceil(active arms / 2) by ascending fitted score using the native argsort order
allocation.random_question_rule: Seeded uniform choice among unseen questions of the selected arm
allocation.balanced_question_rule: Seeded uniform choice among the selected arm's least-covered unseen questions, using counts across all arms including eliminated arms
allocation.native_scope: This pooled replay caps the upstream ceil(log2(K)) formula at five phases. The uncapped formula would give 11 phases for K=1500.

methods.logistic_39: Reference arm-only logistic BAI with 39 covariates and a constant, fitted arm-score ranking, and random questions
methods.rasch39_random: First-version concatenated PE-EmbPT with random questions
methods.rasch39_balanced: First-version concatenated PE-EmbPT with balanced questions
methods.rasch389_random: Second-version model-specific interaction PE-EmbPT with random questions
methods.rasch389_balanced: Second-version model-specific interaction PE-EmbPT with balanced questions
methods.gittins_s: Supplied Figure 3 per-subject LCB cache, dataset prior
methods.gittins_g: Supplied Figure 3 per-subject LCB cache, general prior

reporting.metric: Best full-matrix arm mean minus recommended arm's full-matrix mean
reporting.price_denominator: Subject question count times the sum of fixed per-arm model input-token price weights
reporting.price_view: Reprice the same BAI observation-budgeted histories. Prices are relative weights based on quotes per million input tokens.
reporting.gittins_cache_configuration: Supplied LCB runs use batch size 2 for small subjects, batch size 8 for large subjects, and cost scaling 0.0001.
reporting.gittins_support: Use raw-spend per-subject means and interpolate only within contiguous cache support where all 20 runs contribute. End each curve at the earliest full-support subject endpoint, capped at 10%.
reporting.bai_support: Use latest completed phase at or before the requested budget with a 1e-9 percentage-point tolerance. Carry the final recommendation forward through 10%.
reporting.aggregate_coverage: All 20 seeds for every subject in the group. Subject tables retain available seed counts.
reporting.aggregation: Average seeds within each subject, then average subject means equally
reporting.standard_error: Sample standard error across the equally weighted subject means
reporting.paired_contrasts: Pair seeds within a subject first. The report includes interaction minus concatenated regret for each matched sampler.
reporting.final_phase_note: At unit cost 9.9% precedes the 10% final phase and uses the 8% recommendation.

reproduction.experiment_rerun_inputs: Original repository response matrices and saved feature inputs
